settings.label: Post suggestions to Discord
settings.help: Off: !suggestion does nothing for Discord, and everything below stays as it is.

settings.label: Webhook URL
settings.help: In Discord: channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks > New Webhook > Copy Webhook URL. Several URLs, separated by commas, each get the suggestion. Anyone who has the URL can post to the channel.

settings.label: Send a test suggestion
settings.help: Posts a test under your name and says here whether it arrived. Unsaved changes are saved first.

settings.label: Text
settings.help: %suggestion% is what the viewer wrote, %user% their name, %platform% TWITCH, YOUTUBE or KICK. Discord's Markdown works: **bold**, __underline__, *italic*.

settings.label: Avatar and name under the post
settings.help: The viewer's avatar and name in the post's footer.

settings.label: Platform after the name
settings.help: (TWITCH), (YOUTUBE) or (KICK) after the name.

settings.label: Date and time
settings.help: Discord shows them beside the name, in each reader's own time zone and language.

settings.label: A random colour for every post
settings.help: On: the three colours below are not used.

settings.label: Twitch
settings.help: The bar beside a suggestion from Twitch.

settings.label: YouTube
settings.help: The bar beside a suggestion from YouTube.

settings.label: Kick
settings.help: The bar beside a suggestion from Kick.
Leave these empty to post into the channel of the webhook above. A forum channel needs a webhook of its own, and a thread name or a thread ID.

settings.label: Forum webhook URL
settings.help: A webhook of the forum channel. While it is set, it is used instead of the webhook URL above.

settings.label: A new thread per suggestion, named
settings.help: Every suggestion opens a new forum post with this title; %user% is the viewer's name. Longer than 100 characters is cut.

settings.label: Or all into one thread, with the ID
settings.help: Every suggestion goes into this thread or forum post. In Discord: right-click the thread > Copy Thread ID (needs Developer Mode). With a name and an ID, the ID wins.

settings.label: Post suggestions to Stoat
settings.help: Off: !suggestion does nothing for Stoat, and everything below stays as it is.

settings.label: Webhook URL
settings.help: From the channel's webhook settings in Stoat. Several URLs, separated by commas, each get the suggestion. Anyone who has the URL can post to the channel.

settings.label: Send a test suggestion
settings.help: Posts a test under your name and says here whether it arrived. Unsaved changes are saved first.

settings.label: Text
settings.help: %suggestion% is what the viewer wrote, %user% their name, %platform% TWITCH, YOUTUBE or KICK. Markdown works.

settings.label: Line under the text
settings.help: %user% and %platform% work here too. The viewer's avatar stands in front of it (Twitch and Kick).

settings.label: Date and time
settings.help: Your PC's time, after the line under the text.

settings.label: Time format
settings.help: A .NET date format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm shows 2026-10-25 20:21, dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm shows 25.10.2026 20:21, HH:mm shows 20:21.

lines.what: Posts the text to every server that is switched on. Also !vorschlag.

lines.note: Works from Twitch, YouTube and Kick chat. The viewer gets one confirmation, in the chat the suggestion came from, and only when the post went through.

The three commands are in Streamer.bot's Commands tab, group [SuTo] Suggestions To. Streamer.bot switches them off with every import: right-click the ones you use > Enabled. Change the command words, cooldowns and permissions there, the same for all three.
A webhook URL is a secret: anyone who has it can post to that channel. Do not show these pages on stream, and make a new webhook if one leaks.
Several URLs in one field, separated by commas, each get the suggestion.
